shortDescription: India's ITC NSE:ITC said on Monday its IT arm would acquire a 22.1% stake in IT services provider Happiest Minds Technologies NSE:HAPPSTMNDS for about 13.3 billion rupees ($139.76 million).($1 = 95.1625 Indian rupees)
